traderBrainBase: 10.61 AI Direction Consensus + Sheriff Multi-Source; v10.62 rating-first plan lock
deployment: Active/passive HA overlay for Quaxly + second Node host

marketData.secondary: FUTBIN via Parse API when configured

routes.liveRecheckPrimary: POST /api/uv/recheck/:listId (202 queued CPU-safe async job start)

verification.uvTradingLogic: v2.9.0 preserves the v2.7 Budget Tier Allocator and v2.8.1 rating-first Discord plan. Stability hardening serializes/paces live rechecks, reuses cached demand evidence, prevents overlap with the normal market loop/history monitor, and fails closed on HA lease loss. Dedicated FC27 and HA-return regression tests were added.

uiRevision: v2.9.0 keeps Rating-first/manual player lists and adds CPU-safe live-recheck queue/progress.

traderMethodConsensus.semantics: methodology proxy only; not a claim that any named trader currently recommends a card

safetyPolicy.ratingFloor300k100: live-market preferred floor; demand-backed relaxation is allowed only as needed to reach the hard 100-slot portfolio within budget
safetyPolicy.controlledRepeatPolicy: unique-first; then max 2 exact copies; never a third exact copy
safetyPolicy.specialCardSoftTarget300k100: dynamic promo/live-market target; genuinely liquid in-packs promos raise the mix, supply-only promos do not
safetyPolicy.specialPrioritySemantics: soft target only; price/risk/quality/budget feasibility always override
safetyPolicy.currentFc26EndgameFloor: not hard-coded; live demand/liquidity market floor decides
safetyPolicy.dynamicMarketPolicySemantics: Promo + live liquidity define the preferred quality target. v2.3.6 keeps the strict sellability ladder first, then uses the budget/count slot-price anchor when needed. Normal/Base cards below 82 are never admitted. Sub-82 Specials require strong verified demand. Bronze, low-rated Non-Rare, severe risk/source divergence, price crashes and bad reported outcomes remain blocked. Unique-first, max 2 exact copies, max 3 slots per footballer.
safetyPolicy.budgetFeasibilityFallback: hard 100 slots with sellability ladder, followed by budget-per-slot adaptive sellability fallback when the strict pool is mathematically too expensive
safetyPolicy.promoException: max 1 rating below live floor; in-packs special + strong demand/promo score only
sellabilityEvidencePriority: FUTBIN Games when structured field available
FUTBIN real sold-history evidence when structured field available
FUTBIN popular rank when structured field available
safetyPolicy.budgetAdaptiveSemantics: budget/count sets the slot-price anchor; normal cards remain hard-floored at 82 even in fallback; sub-82 Specials require strong verified demand; multiple demand/activity/trend signals and all hard safety guards remain mandatory

futbinExtendedEvidence.activation: automatic when structured fields appear in existing Parse search response
futbinExtendedEvidence.soldSemantics: sold_for or explicit sold status only; active/expired/unsold are never counted as sales

notes: v2.8.1 restores the agreed rating-first Discord plan: no automatic named player offers; player names are loaded only after the user opens the rating list or manually enables intensive watch.

sharedSnapshotPolicy.generationDuringRecovery: RECENT_SAFE allowed only while FUT.GG status is RECOVERING
sharedSnapshotPolicy.historyMonitorRecoveryBehavior: strict-live; UV_SHARED_MARKET_NOT_READY is treated as DEFERRED, not a hard/sticky monitor error; retry after 10 seconds; no stale snapshot is written as fresh history

budgetTop100Ranking.semantics: Ranks the eligible candidate universe for the requested total budget using sellability/demand, trade quality, PostgreSQL price stability/activity/trend, conservative net profit, data confidence, FUT.GG usage/momentum, budget fit, capital efficiency, Trader Consensus and the v2.7 Budget Tier score. Hard safety gates and total-budget feasibility remain authoritative.

savedLists.liveRecheckPersistence: batched set-based PostgreSQL UPDATE (jsonb_to_recordset), executed inside a server-side async live-recheck job; browser polls short status requests instead of holding one long request

publicTraderEndgameLogic.scope: ENDGAME only; FC27 early cycle automatically returns to neutral prior
publicMethodInputs: historical EA Forums public ÜV consensus on popular leagues/nations, high-rated cards and specials
publicTraderEndgameLogic.staticLeagueNationPrior: small tie-break only; live FUT.GG demand dominates

publicIdeaInputs: FUT.GG Most Used and Momentum demand evidence
FUTZIP-style price stability/volatility concept implemented from own PostgreSQL history
public popularity as a tie-break only

budgetTierAllocator.externalReferenceSemantics: Observed FutStarz 500k/1m/3m/12m list shapes are soft portfolio-shape priors only; no player picks or displayed prices are imported.
budgetTierAllocator.ratingRole: secondary portfolio quality signal; existing hard safety floors/caps remain separate
budgetTierAllocator.versionIdentity: SPECIAL/NORMAL from card item record/cardType; eaId remains card identity
budgetTierAllocator.positionConcentration: soft penalty above budget-dependent position-size threshold unless demand is exceptionally strong
budgetTierAllocator.specialMix: soft and market-adaptive; increases with budget when live candidate quality supports it

liveRecheckTransport.reason: avoid reverse-proxy/network termination of one long 100-card recheck request (browser Failed to fetch)

discordTraderOffers.source: own Trader Brain live market analysis

liveRecheckCpuSafe.demandRefreshDuringManualRecheck: cached evidence only; previous list evidence fallback
